name: David Bleakely
quote: The reconstruction of our Athletic Stadium is a profound change for Marlboro High School.  The new stadium will reflect a standard of excellence that both our student-athletes and our coaches represent every day, and that our community deserves.  While the former stadium served this community well for more than 50 years, I am very excited about the opportunities the new stadium will provide for our school community.  I am also deeply grateful to Mayor Hornik and the Marlboro Township government collectively for making this dream into a reality.

name: Jason Dagato
quote: We look forward to creating memories and special moments on the new field, just as we looked forward to creating them on the old field.  The excitement among the players is palpable and we cannot wait to take that field for the first time in front of our friends, family, and community.  Fridays in Marlboro High School will take on a whole new feeling of excitement.  Every time you take the field as a football player is a sacred experience, and this will only heighten the experience of playing football here at Marlboro High School.

name: Tony Sessa
quote: As a head coach of the Marlboro Mustangs track and field program, I believe the new stadium and turf field will be a transformative step forward for our athletes and community. Upgraded facilities will provide a consistent, high-quality training surface, reduce weather-related disruptions, and help prevent injuries—giving our athletes the tools they need to train harder and smarter. The new stadium would also allow us to host meets that bring pride and visibility to Marlboro High School, strengthening school spirit and attracting future talent. For the Mustangs, this investment isn't just about facilities—it's about building a legacy of excellence.
